title: Key Finding
description: A key research finding — the main final artifact. Produced by `17-key-findings`. Stored as Markdown `3-analysis/findings/F0X.md` and aggregated in `3-analysis/findings.md`.

rank.description: Rank by strength of the evidence base. 1 = the strongest.

statement.description: One-line statement with an explicit 'so what?'. NOT a data recap ('respondents often mentioned X'), but a conclusion ('users rely on search as a crutch for navigation because the menu is unclear to them').

elaboration.description: 1–3 paragraphs of detailed reasoning. Connected prose, not lists.

addresses_research_questions.description: Which research questions it addresses. A finding that answers no research question goes into 'new hypotheses', not into the main findings.

is_new_hypothesis.description: true — the finding was not among the original hypotheses; it is material for follow-up research. In the report it goes into the 'new hypotheses' section.

supporting_themes.description: Themes supporting the finding (from axial coding).

supporting_types.description: Which behavioral types the finding relates to (if a typology was built).

respondents.description: Respondents supporting the finding. At least 4 — otherwise it is a case, not a finding.

quotes.description: At least 2 verbatim quotes. Each passes a verbatim check against `.system/coded/*.json`.

boundaries.description: Boundaries of applicability: where it does not hold, in which segment the opposite is true.

disconfirms.description: Cases that contradict the finding. They do not make the finding false — they set its boundaries.

confidence.description: Confidence in the finding. Depends on: number of respondents, diversity of segments, presence of disconfirming cases, triangulation.

confidence_rationale.description: 1–2 sentences on why the confidence is what it is.

statement.description: A CONCRETE product implication. NOT 'improve UX', but 'move button X on page Y'.

addressee.description: Who it is addressed to: 'the onboarding team', 'the search design team', 'the CRM product manager', etc.

expected_effect.description: What will change in user behavior or in a metric.

failed_quotes.description: segment_ids of quotes that failed the check. If the array is non-empty — passed=false and the finding is marked draft.

verbatim_check.description: Result of checking that every quote in evidence.quotes exists verbatim in `.system/coded/*.json`.
